sql.48b1c36ab6:
select (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', "outfit_calendar"."id",
      'day', "outfit_calendar"."day",
      'occasion', "outfit_calendar"."occasion",
      'worn', "outfit_calendar"."worn_at" is not null,
      'plannedBy', "outfit_calendar"."planned_by",
      'agent', case when "outfit_calendar"."planned_by" = 'agent' then coalesce((
    select json_build_object('kind', 'token', 'name', stamp_token.name)
    from "personal_access_token" stamp_token
    inner join "user" stamp_author on stamp_author.id = stamp_token.user_id
    where stamp_token.id = "outfit_calendar"."planned_by_token_id"
  ), json_build_object('kind', 'anonymous')) end,
      'selfie', (
    select json_build_object(
      'id', "selfie"."id",
      'photo', json_build_object('fileName', "file"."file_name", 'version', "file"."version")
    )
    from "selfie" inner join "file" on "file"."id" = "selfie"."photo_id"
    where "selfie"."outfit_calendar_id" = "outfit_calendar"."id"),
      'outfit', json_build_object(
        'id', "outfit"."id",
        'name', "outfit"."name",
        'kept', "outfit"."origin" in ($1, $2),
        'createdOneOff', coalesce("outfit_calendar"."outfit_created", false)
          and "outfit"."origin" in ($3, $4),
        'garments', (
          select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
            'id', "garment"."id",
            'name', "garment"."name",
            'category', "garment"."category",
            'photo', case when not ("file"."id" is not null and "file"."original_missing_since" is null) then null else json_build_object('fileName', "file"."file_name", 'version', "file"."version", 'variantKey', "file"."variant_key") end,
            'status', "garment"."status",
            'away', "garment"."away",
            'needsWash', (case when "outfit_calendar"."day" = $5 and "outfit_calendar"."worn_at" is null then (case when (case when "garment"."wash_after_wears" = 0 then null else coalesce("garment"."wash_after_wears", case "garment"."category" when 'outerwear' then 10 when 'dresses' then 1 when 'tops' then 1 when 'bottoms' then 3 end) end) is null then 0 else least("garment"."quantity", (select count(distinct "garment_wear"."day")::int from "garment_wear" where "garment_wear"."garment_id" = "garment"."id" and ("garment"."last_washed_on" is null or "garment_wear"."day" > "garment"."last_washed_on" or ("garment_wear"."day" = "garment"."last_washed_on" and "garment_wear"."worn_at" > "garment"."washed_at"))) / (case when "garment"."wash_after_wears" = 0 then null else coalesce("garment"."wash_after_wears", case "garment"."category" when 'outerwear' then 10 when 'dresses' then 1 when 'tops' then 1 when 'bottoms' then 3 end) end)) end)::int >= "garment"."quantity" else false end)
          ) order by "outfit_slot"."position"), '[]')
          from "outfit_slot"
          inner join "garment" on "garment"."id" = "outfit_slot"."garment_id"
          left join "file" on "file"."id" = "garment"."photo_id"
          where "outfit_slot"."outfit_id" = "outfit"."id"
        )
      )
    ) order by "outfit_calendar"."day", "outfit_calendar"."id"), '[]')
    from "outfit_calendar"
    inner join "outfit" on "outfit"."id" = "outfit_calendar"."outfit_id"
    where "outfit_calendar"."owner_id" = $6
      and "outfit_calendar"."day" between $7 and $8) as "entries", (
    select json_build_object(
      'settings', json_build_object(
        'userId', "user_weather"."user_id",
        'homeName', "user_weather"."home_name",
        'homeLatitude', "user_weather"."home_latitude",
        'homeLongitude', "user_weather"."home_longitude",
        'hereLatitude', "user_weather"."here_latitude",
        'hereLongitude', "user_weather"."here_longitude",
        'hereLocatedAt', "user_weather"."here_located_at",
        'temperatureOffset', "user_weather"."temperature_offset",
        'temperatureUnit', "user_weather"."temperature_unit"
      ),
      'joinedLatitude', case when "user_weather"."here_located_at" > $9
    then "user_weather"."here_latitude" else "user_weather"."home_latitude" end,
      'joinedLongitude', case when "user_weather"."here_located_at" > $10
    then "user_weather"."here_longitude" else "user_weather"."home_longitude" end,
      'value', "weather_forecast"."forecast",
      'fetchedAt', "weather_forecast"."fetched_at",
      'attemptedAt', "weather_forecast"."attempted_at"
    ) from "user_weather"
    left join "weather_forecast"
      on "weather_forecast"."latitude" = case when "user_weather"."here_located_at" > $11
    then "user_weather"."here_latitude" else "user_weather"."home_latitude" end
      and "weather_forecast"."longitude" = case when "user_weather"."here_located_at" > $12
    then "user_weather"."here_longitude" else "user_weather"."home_longitude" end
      and "weather_forecast"."time_zone" = $13 where "user_weather"."user_id" = $14) as "weather", (
    select case when count(*) = 0 then null else json_build_object(
      'count', count(*)::int,
      'agent', (array_agg(case when "option_group"."suggested_by_token_id" is not null then coalesce((
    select json_build_object('kind', 'token', 'name', stamp_token.name)
    from "personal_access_token" stamp_token
    inner join "user" stamp_author on stamp_author.id = stamp_token.user_id
    where stamp_token.id = "option_group"."suggested_by_token_id"
  ), json_build_object('kind', 'anonymous')) end order by "option_group"."id" desc))[1]
    ) end
    from "option_group"
    where ("option_group"."owner_id" = $15 and "option_group"."status" = $16 and exists (select 1 from "garment" where ("garment"."suggestion_group_id" = "option_group"."id" and ("garment"."status" = $17 and "garment"."dismissed_at" is null))))
  ) as "needs", (
    select case when counted.outfits + counted.pieces = 0 then null else json_build_object(
      'id', counted.id,
      'agent', counted.agent,
      'summary', counted.summary,
      'outfits', counted.outfits,
      'pieces', counted.pieces
    ) end
    from (
      select "latest".id, "latest".summary,
        case when "latest".token_id is not null then coalesce((
    select json_build_object('kind', 'token', 'name', stamp_token.name)
    from "personal_access_token" stamp_token
    inner join "user" stamp_author on stamp_author.id = stamp_token.user_id
    where stamp_token.id = "latest".token_id
  ), json_build_object('kind', 'anonymous')) end as agent,
        (select count(*)::int from "outfit" where ("outfit"."owner_id" = $18 and (("outfit"."proposed_at" is not null and not ("outfit"."proposed_at" is null or ("outfit"."reaction" = 'loved' and not exists (select 1 from "outfit_slot"
    inner join "garment" on "garment"."id" = "outfit_slot"."garment_id"
    where ("outfit_slot"."outfit_id" = "outfit"."id" and "garment"."status" = $19))))) and "outfit"."reaction" <> 'declined') and ("outfit"."proposed_at" > coalesce("latest".since, '-infinity'::timestamptz) and "outfit"."proposed_at" <= "latest".finished_at))) as outfits,
        (select count(*)::int from "garment" where ("garment"."owner_id" = $20 and (("garment"."status" = $21 and "garment"."dismissed_at" is null) and "garment"."suggestion_group_id" in (
  select "option_group"."id" from "option_group" where "option_group"."status" = 'open'
)) and ("garment"."suggested_at" > coalesce("latest".since, '-infinity'::timestamptz) and "garment"."suggested_at" <= "latest".finished_at))) as pieces
      from "muse_round" as "latest"
      where "latest".owner_id = $22
      order by "latest".finished_at desc, "latest".id desc
      limit 1
    ) as counted
  ) as "round", (
    select coalesce(json_agg(kinds), '[]')
    from (
      select distinct "garment"."category" as category, "garment"."type" as type
      from "garment"
      where ("garment"."owner_id" = $23 and "garment"."status" = $24)
    ) kinds
  ) as "closet", (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', "trip"."id",
      'name', "trip"."name",
      'destination', "trip"."destination",
      'startsOn', "trip"."starts_on",
      'endsOn', "trip"."ends_on"
    ) order by "trip"."starts_on", "trip"."id"), '[]')
    from "trip"
    where "trip"."owner_id" = $25
      and "trip"."starts_on" <= $26
      and "trip"."ends_on" >= $27) as "away"

    )), '[]')

    left join "file" on "file"."id" = "garment"."photo_id"
    where ("garment"."owner_id" = $2 and ("garment"."status" = $3 and "garment"."away" is null and (case when (case when "garment"."wash_after_wears" = 0 then null else coalesce("garment"."wash_after_wears", case "garment"."category" when 'outerwear' then 10 when 'dresses' then 1 when 'tops' then 1 when 'bottoms' then 3 end) end) is null then 0 else least("garment"."quantity", (select count(distinct "garment_wear"."day")::int from "garment_wear" where "garment_wear"."garment_id" = "garment"."id" and ("garment"."last_washed_on" is null or "garment_wear"."day" > "garment"."last_washed_on" or ("garment_wear"."day" = "garment"."last_washed_on" and "garment_wear"."worn_at" > "garment"."washed_at"))) / (case when "garment"."wash_after_wears" = 0 then null else coalesce("garment"."wash_after_wears", case "garment"."category" when 'outerwear' then 10 when 'dresses' then 1 when 'tops' then 1 when 'bottoms' then 3 end) end)) end)::int < "garment"."quantity"))

  ) as "avoid", (

    json_build_array("outfit_rule"."b_garment_id", "outfit_rule"."b_category", "outfit_rule"."b_type", "outfit_rule"."b_color", "outfit_rule"."b_pattern")
  ) order by "outfit_rule"."id"), '[]')

select (select count(*)::int from "garment" where ("garment"."owner_id" = $1 and "garment"."status" = $2)) as "count", (
    select json_build_object(
      'categories', coalesce(array_agg(distinct "garment"."category") filter (where "garment"."category" is not null), '{}'),
      'sizes', coalesce(array_agg(distinct "garment"."size") filter (where "garment"."size" is not null), '{}'),
      'types', coalesce(array_agg(distinct "garment"."type") filter (where "garment"."type" is not null), '{}'),
      'warmths', coalesce(array_agg(distinct "garment"."warmth") filter (where "garment"."warmth" is not null), '{}'),
      'formalities', coalesce(array_agg(distinct "garment"."formality") filter (where "garment"."formality" is not null), '{}'),
      'washes', coalesce(array_agg(distinct "garment"."care_wash") filter (where "garment"."care_wash" is not null), '{}'),
      'materials', (
        select coalesce(array_agg(distinct worn.material), '{}')
        from garment owned cross join lateral unnest(owned.materials) as worn(material)
        where owned.owner_id = $3 and owned.status <> 'wishlist'
      )
    )
    from "garment"
    where ("garment"."owner_id" = $4 and "garment"."status" <> $5)
  ) as "options", (
    select coalesce(
      json_agg(
        json_build_object('id', "capsule"."id", 'name', "capsule"."name")
        order by lower("capsule"."name") asc, "capsule"."id" asc
      ),
      '[]'
    )
    from "capsule"
    where "capsule"."owner_id" = $6
  ) as "capsules", (select count(*)::int from "garment" where ("garment"."owner_id" = $7 and "garment"."status" = $8 and ("garment"."formality" is null or ("garment"."warmth" is null and "garment"."category" not in ($9)) or ("garment"."type" is null and "garment"."category" in ($10, $11, $12, $13, $14, $15, $16))))) as "toTag", (select count(*)::int from "garment" where ("garment"."owner_id" = $17 and "garment"."status" = $18 and "garment"."away" is null and (case when (case when "garment"."wash_after_wears" = 0 then null else coalesce("garment"."wash_after_wears", case "garment"."category" when 'outerwear' then 10 when 'dresses' then 1 when 'tops' then 1 when 'bottoms' then 3 end) end) is null then 0 else least("garment"."quantity", (select count(distinct "garment_wear"."day")::int from "garment_wear" where "garment_wear"."garment_id" = "garment"."id" and ("garment"."last_washed_on" is null or "garment_wear"."day" > "garment"."last_washed_on" or ("garment_wear"."day" = "garment"."last_washed_on" and "garment_wear"."worn_at" > "garment"."washed_at"))) / (case when "garment"."wash_after_wears" = 0 then null else coalesce("garment"."wash_after_wears", case "garment"."category" when 'outerwear' then 10 when 'dresses' then 1 when 'tops' then 1 when 'bottoms' then 3 end) end)) end)::int > 0)) as "toWash", (
    select json_build_object('first', "pending_photo"."file_name", 'count', count(*) over ())
    from "pending_photo"
    where ("pending_photo"."user_id" = $19 and "pending_photo"."batch_owner_id" = $20)
    order by "pending_photo"."created_at" asc, "pending_photo"."batch_id" asc, "pending_photo"."batch_position" asc
    limit 1
  ) as "drafts", (
    select coalesce(
      json_agg(
        json_build_object(
          'grantorId', "wardrobe_share"."grantor_id",
          'firstName', "user"."first_name",
          'email', "user"."email",
          'permission', "wardrobe_share"."permission"
        )
        order by "wardrobe_share"."id"
      ),
      '[]'
    )
    from "wardrobe_share"
    join "user" on "user"."id" = "wardrobe_share"."grantor_id"

    select coalesce(
      json_agg(

    where "outfit_slot"."outfit_id" = "outfit"."id"
  ) as garments

    where ("outfit"."owner_id" = $13 and "outfit"."id" in (select "outfit_slot"."outfit_id" from "outfit_slot" where "outfit_slot"."garment_id" = $14) and ("outfit"."proposed_at" is null or ("outfit"."reaction" = 'loved' and not exists (select 1 from "outfit_slot"

    where ("generator_avoid"."owner_id" = $18 and ("generator_avoid"."garment_a_id" = $19 or "generator_avoid"."garment_b_id" = $20))

          'kind', "garment_repair"."kind",

select (

      'garments', (
        select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array("garment"."id", "garment"."name", "garment"."category", "garment"."status", case when ("file"."id" is not null and "file"."original_missing_since" is null) then "file"."file_name" end, "file"."version", "file"."variant_key") order by "outfit_slot"."position"), '[]')
        from "outfit_slot"

        where "outfit_slot"."outfit_id" = "outfit"."id"
      )
    )
    from "outfit"
    where ("outfit"."id" = $1 and "outfit"."owner_id" = $2)
  ) as "outfit", (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array(
      windowed.role, windowed.count, windowed.id, windowed.name,
      windowed.category, windowed.status, case when ("file"."id" is not null and "file"."original_missing_since" is null) then "file"."file_name" end, "file"."version",
      "file"."variant_key"
    ) order by windowed.rank), '[]')
    from (
      select ranked.*, coalesce(max(case when (exists (select from unnest(array[]::int[], array[]::text[]) as chosen (id, role) where chosen.id = ranked.id and chosen.role = ranked.role) or ranked.id in (select "outfit_slot"."garment_id" from "outfit_slot" inner join "outfit" on "outfit"."id" = "outfit_slot"."outfit_id" where ("outfit"."id" = $3 and "outfit"."owner_id" = $4))) then ranked.rank end) over (partition by ranked.role), 0) as deepest
      from (
        select "garment"."id" as id, "garment"."name" as name,
          "garment"."category" as category, "garment"."status" as status,
          "garment"."photo_id" as photo_id, case when "garment"."category" = $5 then $6 when "garment"."category" = $7 then $8 when "garment"."category" = $9 then $10 when "garment"."category" = $11 then $12 when "garment"."category" = $13 then $14 when "garment"."category" = $15 then $16 when "garment"."category" = $17 then $18 else 'none' end as role,
          (row_number() over (partition by case when "garment"."category" = $19 then $20 when "garment"."category" = $21 then $22 when "garment"."category" = $23 then $24 when "garment"."category" = $25 then $26 when "garment"."category" = $27 then $28 when "garment"."category" = $29 then $30 when "garment"."category" = $31 then $32 else 'none' end order by "garment"."id" desc))::int as rank,
          (count(*) over (partition by case when "garment"."category" = $33 then $34 when "garment"."category" = $35 then $36 when "garment"."category" = $37 then $38 when "garment"."category" = $39 then $40 when "garment"."category" = $41 then $42 when "garment"."category" = $43 then $44 when "garment"."category" = $45 then $46 else 'none' end))::int as count
        from "garment"
        where ("garment"."owner_id" = $47 and "garment"."status" = $48)
      ) ranked
    ) windowed
    left join "file" on "file"."id" = windowed.photo_id
    where windowed.rank <= windowed.deepest + $49
  ) as "windows", ($50::int in (select "outfit_calendar"."outfit_id" from "outfit_calendar" union all select "trip_outfit"."outfit_id" from "trip_outfit")) as "editingHeld", (

        order by lower("capsule"."name") asc, "capsule"."id" asc
      ),

    )

      from "garment"
      where ("garment"."owner_id" = $52 and "garment"."status" = $53)

  ) as "closetKinds"

    where "outfit_calendar"."owner_id" = $5
      and "outfit_calendar"."day" between $6 and $7) as "entries", (
    select json_build_object(
      'settings', json_build_object(
        'userId', "user_weather"."user_id",
        'homeName', "user_weather"."home_name",
        'homeLatitude', "user_weather"."home_latitude",
        'homeLongitude', "user_weather"."home_longitude",
        'hereLatitude', "user_weather"."here_latitude",
        'hereLongitude', "user_weather"."here_longitude",
        'hereLocatedAt', "user_weather"."here_located_at",
        'temperatureOffset', "user_weather"."temperature_offset",
        'temperatureUnit', "user_weather"."temperature_unit"
      ),
      'joinedLatitude', case when "user_weather"."here_located_at" > $8
    then "user_weather"."here_latitude" else "user_weather"."home_latitude" end,
      'joinedLongitude', case when "user_weather"."here_located_at" > $9
    then "user_weather"."here_longitude" else "user_weather"."home_longitude" end,
      'value', "weather_forecast"."forecast",
      'fetchedAt', "weather_forecast"."fetched_at",
      'attemptedAt', "weather_forecast"."attempted_at"
    ) from "user_weather"
    left join "weather_forecast"
      on "weather_forecast"."latitude" = case when "user_weather"."here_located_at" > $10
    then "user_weather"."here_latitude" else "user_weather"."home_latitude" end
      and "weather_forecast"."longitude" = case when "user_weather"."here_located_at" > $11
    then "user_weather"."here_longitude" else "user_weather"."home_longitude" end
      and "weather_forecast"."time_zone" = $12 where "user_weather"."user_id" = $13) as "weather"

    select json_build_object('kind', 'token', 'name', stamp_token.name)
    from "personal_access_token" stamp_token
    inner join "user" stamp_author on stamp_author.id = stamp_token.user_id
    where stamp_token.id = "trip_outfit"."planned_by_token_id"
  ), json_build_object('kind', 'anonymous')) end,
        'garments', (

      json_agg(
        json_build_object(
          'id', "garment"."id",
          'name', "garment"."name",
          'category', "garment"."category",
          'status', "garment"."status",
          'photo', case when not ("file"."id" is not null and "file"."original_missing_since" is null) then null else json_build_object('fileName', "file"."file_name", 'version', "file"."version", 'variantKey', "file"."variant_key") end
        )
        order by "outfit_slot"."position"
      ),
      '[]'
    )
    from "outfit_slot"
    join "garment" on "garment"."id" = "outfit_slot"."garment_id"
    left join "file" on "file"."id" = "garment"."photo_id"
    where "outfit_slot"."outfit_id" = "outfit"."id"
  )
      )),
      '[]'
    )
    from "trip_outfit"
    inner join "outfit" on "outfit"."id" = "trip_outfit"."outfit_id"
    where ("trip_outfit"."trip_id" = $3 and "outfit"."owner_id" = $4)

        'name', "garment"."name",
        'category', "garment"."category",
        'quantity', "garment"."quantity",

        'wearsSinceWash', (select count(distinct "garment_wear"."day")::int from "garment_wear" where "garment_wear"."garment_id" = "garment"."id" and ("garment"."last_washed_on" is null or "garment_wear"."day" > "garment"."last_washed_on" or ("garment_wear"."day" = "garment"."last_washed_on" and "garment_wear"."worn_at" > "garment"."washed_at"))),
        'packed', exists (
          select 1 from "trip_garment_packed"

        )
      )),

    )
    from "garment"
    left join "file" on "file"."id" = "garment"."photo_id"

  ) as "garments", (
    select coalesce(
      json_agg(
        json_build_object('id', "trip_item"."id", 'label', "trip_item"."label", 'packed', "trip_item"."packed")

    from "trip_item"
    where "trip_item"."trip_id" = $8 and exists (select 1 from "trip" where ("trip"."id" = $9 and "trip"."owner_id" = $10))

    )
    from "outfit_calendar"
    where ("outfit_calendar"."owner_id" = $11 and "outfit_calendar"."day" = $12 and "outfit_calendar"."worn_at" is not null)
  ) as "wornToday"

select (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', "option_group"."id",
      'name', "option_group"."name",
      'budget', "option_group"."budget"::text,
      'note', "option_group"."note",
      'status', "option_group"."status",
      'resolvedGarmentId', "option_group"."resolved_garment_id",
      'dismissedReason', "option_group"."dismissed_reason",
      'ownerNote', "option_group"."owner_note",
      'agent', case when "option_group"."suggested_by_token_id" is not null then coalesce((
    select case
          when stamp_token.user_id = $1::int
            then json_build_object('kind', 'token', 'name', stamp_token.name)
          when $2::boolean and nullif(stamp_author.first_name, '') is not null
            then json_build_object('kind', 'person', 'firstName', stamp_author.first_name)
        end
    from "personal_access_token" stamp_token
    inner join "user" stamp_author on stamp_author.id = stamp_token.user_id
    where stamp_token.id = "option_group"."suggested_by_token_id"
  ), json_build_object('kind', 'anonymous')) end,
      'picks', (
  select coalesce(
    json_agg(json_build_object(
  'id', "garment"."id",
  'name', "garment"."name",
  'brand', "garment"."brand",
  'category', "garment"."category",
  'price', "garment"."price"::text,
  'sourceUrl', "garment"."source_url",
  'photo', case when not ("file"."id" is not null and "file"."original_missing_since" is null) then null else json_build_object('fileName', "file"."file_name", 'version', "file"."version", 'variantKey', "file"."variant_key") end,
  'rank', "garment"."suggestion_rank",
  'note', "garment"."suggestion_note",
  'dismissedAt', "garment"."dismissed_at",
  'dismissedReason', "garment"."dismissed_reason",
  'dismissedNote', "garment"."dismissed_note"
) order by "garment"."suggestion_rank" nulls last, "garment"."id"),
    '[]'
  )
  from "garment"
  left join "file" on "file"."id" = "garment"."photo_id"
  where ("garment"."suggestion_group_id" = "option_group"."id" and "garment"."status" = $3)
),
      'resolver', (
  select json_build_object(

    'category', "resolver"."category",

  where "resolver"."id" = "option_group"."resolved_garment_id"
)
    ) order by "option_group"."id"), '[]')
    from "option_group"
    where ("option_group"."owner_id" = $4 and ("option_group"."status" <> 'resolved' or exists (
  select 1 from "garment" as "resolver"
  where "resolver"."id" = "option_group"."resolved_garment_id"
    and "resolver"."status" = 'wishlist'
)))
  ) as "needs", (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', "garment"."id",
      'name', "garment"."name",
      'brand', "garment"."brand",
      'category', "garment"."category",
      'price', "garment"."price"::text,
      'sourceUrl', "garment"."source_url",
      'photo', case when not ("file"."id" is not null and "file"."original_missing_since" is null) then null else json_build_object('fileName', "file"."file_name", 'version', "file"."version", 'variantKey', "file"."variant_key") end,
      'suggested', "garment"."suggested_at" is not null,
      'agent', case when "garment"."suggested_by_token_id" is not null then coalesce((
    select case
          when stamp_token.user_id = $5::int
            then json_build_object('kind', 'token', 'name', stamp_token.name)
          when $6::boolean and nullif(stamp_author.first_name, '') is not null
            then json_build_object('kind', 'person', 'firstName', stamp_author.first_name)
        end
    from "personal_access_token" stamp_token
    inner join "user" stamp_author on stamp_author.id = stamp_token.user_id
    where stamp_token.id = "garment"."suggested_by_token_id"
  ), json_build_object('kind', 'anonymous')) end,
      'dismissedAt', "garment"."dismissed_at",
      'dismissedReason', "garment"."dismissed_reason",
      'replaces', case when "replaced"."id" is null then null else json_build_object(
        'id', "replaced"."id",
        'name', "replaced"."name",
        'category', "replaced"."category",
        'status', "replaced"."status"
      ) end
    ) order by "garment"."id" desc), '[]')
    from "garment"
    left join "file" on "file"."id" = "garment"."photo_id"
    left join "garment" as "replaced" on "replaced"."id" = "garment"."replaces_garment_id"
    where ("garment"."owner_id" = $7 and "garment"."status" = $8 and "garment"."suggestion_group_id" is null and ("garment"."dismissed_at" is null or "garment"."suggested_at" is not null))
  ) as "own", (
    select coalesce(
      json_agg(
        json_build_object(
          'id', "brand_size"."id",
          'brand', "brand_size"."brand",
          'size', "brand_size"."size",
          'note', "brand_size"."note"
        )
        order by "brand_size"."brand_key"
      ),
      '[]'
    )
    from "brand_size"
    where "brand_size"."user_id" = $9
  ) as "brandSizes", json_build_object(
    'items', (
      select coalesce(
        json_agg(json_build_array(json_build_array(
  "garment"."id", "garment"."name", "garment"."category", "garment"."colors",
  "garment"."pattern", "garment"."formality", "garment"."warmth", "garment"."type",
  "garment"."fabric_weight", "garment"."water_resistant",
  case when ("file"."id" is not null and "file"."original_missing_since" is null) then "file"."file_name" end, "file"."version", "file"."variant_key"
), "garment"."replaces_garment_id") order by "garment"."id"),
        '[]'
      )
      from "garment"
      left join "file" on "file"."id" = "garment"."photo_id"
      where ("garment"."owner_id" = $10 and "garment"."status" = $11 and (("garment"."status" = $12 and "garment"."dismissed_at" is null) and "garment"."suggestion_group_id" in (
  select "option_group"."id" from "option_group" where "option_group"."status" = 'open'
)))
    ),

  "garment"."pattern", "garment"."formality", "garment"."warmth", "garment"."type",
  "garment"."fabric_weight", "garment"."water_resistant",
  case when ("file"."id" is not null and "file"."original_missing_since" is null) then "file"."file_name" end, "file"."version", "file"."variant_key"
) order by "garment"."id"), '[]')
    from "garment"
    left join "file" on "file"."id" = "garment"."photo_id"
    where ("garment"."owner_id" = $13 and "garment"."status" = $14)
  ),
    'avoid', (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array("generator_avoid"."garment_a_id", "generator_avoid"."garment_b_id")), '[]')
    from "generator_avoid"
    where "generator_avoid"."owner_id" = $15
  ),
    'rules', (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array(
    "outfit_rule"."kind",
    json_build_array("outfit_rule"."a_garment_id", "outfit_rule"."a_category", "outfit_rule"."a_type", "outfit_rule"."a_color", "outfit_rule"."a_pattern"),
    json_build_array("outfit_rule"."b_garment_id", "outfit_rule"."b_category", "outfit_rule"."b_type", "outfit_rule"."b_color", "outfit_rule"."b_pattern")

    from "outfit_rule"
    where "outfit_rule"."owner_id" = $16

sql.85885b7354:
with "cursor" as (
      select "personal_access_token"."feedback_read_at" as since
      from "personal_access_token" where "personal_access_token"."id" = $1
    )
    select
      -- As JSON, as the lists' times: an ISO string, not the driver's Date.
      to_json((select since from "cursor")) #>> '{}' as since,
      to_json(now() - $2::interval) #>> '{}' as until,
      (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'needId', "option_group"."id",
      'need', "option_group"."name",
      'decision', case
        when "option_group"."status" = 'dismissed' then 'set_aside'
        when "garment"."status" = 'wishlist' then 'chosen'
        else 'bought'
      end,
      'garment', case when "garment"."id" is null then null else json_build_object(
        'id', "garment"."id", 'name', "garment"."name", 'sourceUrl', "garment"."source_url"
      ) end,
      'reason', "option_group"."dismissed_reason",
      'ownerNote', "option_group"."owner_note",
      'at', "option_group"."decided_at"
    ) order by "option_group"."decided_at", "option_group"."id"), '[]')
    from "option_group"
    left join "garment" on "garment"."id" = "option_group"."resolved_garment_id"
    where ("option_group"."owner_id" = $3 and "option_group"."status" <> $4 and ((select since from "cursor") is null or "option_group"."decided_at" > (select since from "cursor")))
  ) as needs,
      (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'garmentId', "garment"."id",
      'name', "garment"."name",
      'sourceUrl', "garment"."source_url",
      'needId', "option_group"."id",
      'need', "option_group"."name",
      'reason', "garment"."dismissed_reason",
      'note', "garment"."dismissed_note",
      'at', "garment"."dismissed_at"
    ) order by "garment"."dismissed_at", "garment"."id"), '[]')
    from "garment"
    left join "option_group" on "option_group"."id" = "garment"."suggestion_group_id"
    where ("garment"."owner_id" = $5 and "garment"."suggested_at" is not null and "garment"."dismissed_at" is not null and ((select since from "cursor") is null or "garment"."dismissed_at" > (select since from "cursor")))
  ) as "picksSetAside",
      (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'garmentId', "garment"."id",
      'name', "garment"."name",
      'sourceUrl', "garment"."source_url",
      'needId', coalesce("garment"."suggestion_group_id", (
        select "option_group"."id" from "option_group"
        where "option_group"."resolved_garment_id" = "garment"."id"
      )),
      'different', "garment"."suggested_at" is null,
      'pricePaid', "garment"."price"::text,
      'boughtOn', "garment"."acquired_on"::text,
      'at', "garment"."bought_at"
    ) order by "garment"."bought_at" nulls first, "garment"."id"), '[]')
    from "garment"
    where (("garment"."owner_id" = $6 and "garment"."status" <> $7 and ("garment"."suggested_at" is not null or "garment"."id" in (
      select "option_group"."resolved_garment_id" from "option_group"
      where "option_group"."owner_id" = $8
    ))) and ((select since from "cursor") is null or "garment"."bought_at" > (select since from "cursor")))
  ) as purchases,
      (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'outfitId', "outfit"."id",
      'name', "outfit"."name",
      'reaction', "outfit"."reaction",
      'reason', "outfit"."dismissed_reason",
      'ownerNote', "outfit"."owner_note",
      'garmentIds', (
        select coalesce(json_agg("outfit_slot"."garment_id" order by "outfit_slot"."position"), '[]')
        from "outfit_slot"
        where ("outfit_slot"."outfit_id" = "outfit"."id" and "outfit_slot"."garment_id" is not null)
      ),
      'at', "outfit"."reacted_at"
    ) order by "outfit"."reacted_at" nulls first, "outfit"."id"), '[]')
    from "outfit"
    where ("outfit"."owner_id" = $9 and "outfit"."proposed_at" is not null and ("outfit"."reaction" <> 'proposed' or "outfit"."reacted_at" is not null) and ((select since from "cursor") is null or "outfit"."reacted_at" > (select since from "cursor")))
  ) as outfits,
      (
    select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'garmentId', "garment"."id",
      'name', "garment"."name",
      'status', "garment"."status",
